scope: Preflight supports only exact structured mappings from work-authorization and sponsorship questions to their explicit saved career-profile preference fields. It does not infer, echo, or fill either response.

acceptance.explicit_structured_values: PASS; only full-label supported work-authorization and present/future sponsorship question forms with the exact corresponding preference path pass when saved values are explicit and unambiguous.
acceptance.missing_or_ambiguous_values: PASS; blank, unknown, unspecified, modal/uncertain, maybe, probably, and not-sure work-authorization values plus NOT_SPECIFIED sponsorship remain UNKNOWN with LEGAL_PROFILE_VALUE_UNAVAILABLE and a question-only missing record.
acceptance.unrelated_legal_attestations: PASS; criminal-history, age, citizenship, mismapped fields, compound work-authorization/sponsorship questions, historical-only sponsorship questions, and unsupported paths remain UNKNOWN or UNMAPPED_REQUIRED_QUESTION.
acceptance.ordinary_question_control: PASS; an ordinary question satisfied by the existing approved answer mapping remains PASS.
acceptance.persistence_and_redaction: PASS; a connected preflight audit/readback persists the supported mapping but neither explicit profile value appears in the result or audit payload.
acceptance.pre_browser_stop: PASS; unrelated legal clauses combined with a supported authorization question, and mixed-class required legal questions, transition the synthetic application to REVIEW_REQUIRED before Playwright, with zero application-attempt rows.
acceptance.submission_safety: PASS; no external application submission path was invoked.

red_first_observation.details: Red-first regressions reproduced false PASS for compound authorization-plus-felony/background, age, and citizenship clauses; work-authorization values prefixed by 'I think' or 'probably'; and historical-only sponsorship wording. The connected compound-question regression also showed Playwright was reached. These cases now remain UNKNOWN without echoing profile values or starting the browser. Earlier missing-path and mixed authorization/sponsorship class findings are preserved in prior verification records.

checks.target: Synthetic SQLite/API preflight, durable audit readback, redaction, ordinary control, exact supported question forms, ambiguity denial, mixed/unrelated clause denial, and pre-browser stop

environment.ATS: Local synthetic mock fixture; browser launch patched and asserted absent for the blocked case

limitations: Only the bounded preflight behavior is covered; broader application automation and all other legally significant profile fields remain outside this slice.
A passing preflight does not populate or submit legal responses; values remain private profile state and require downstream user handling.
Hosted checks and live employer ATS validation were not run.
